title: Incorrect `last_point.blk` calculation due to shared memory in `_checkpoint()`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  In the `_checkpoint` function of the VotingEscrow contract, there's an issue with how `initial_last_point` is assigned as a reference to `last_point` instead of creating an independent copy.
